newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Dini sees no problem for govt. stability.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Dini sees no problem for govt. stability.

text.p: Italian Foregn Minister Lamberto Dini said on Thursday that he saw no problems arising for the government's stability after the shock resignation of Public Works Minister Antonio Di Pietro.

Asked by a Reuters reporter whether he believed the government could be endangered following Di Pietro's departure, Dini replied: "I really do not think so. But it is up to Prime Minister Prodi to express his own view."
